title: Chuyên đề thực tế - Kinh tế và quản lý đô thị

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply knowledge on urban economic activities and management tools in domestic and international contexts.
Identify problems in urban management and propose solutions based on theoretical knowledge.
Ability to search for, analyze, synthesize, and generalize issues related to urban development and management.
Work independently and collaboratively to solve assigned tasks.
Ability to self-study, accumulate experience, and improve professional competence to adapt to changes in urban management environment.
Develop critical thinking and systematic thinking skills.
Manage resources effectively for professional management activities in the urban field.
Apply theoretical knowledge to analyze, evaluate, and explain urban economic and management issues.
